content:
We are organising a three-day Lean Tutorial in Vienna on Sept. 18-20. The
intended audience of this tutorial are mathematicians from all research areas
who are curious about this topic and want to learn how to use Lean.

There will be several talks, given by Lean experts, to explain the basics and
provide examples, as well as practice sessions, where participants will use
Lean in real world situations on their own laptops.

Participation is free of charge, but registration is mandatory. The
registration deadline is August 31. For more information, please visit the
website of this event.
Would you recommend the event for non-German speakers as well? (E.g. will the talks and workshops be held in English?)
Sure, the entire event will be in English.
Will there be recordings of this by any chance?
No, we did not plan any recordings.
